title: Mixture-of-Loops Transformer
abstract: arXiv:2611.34923v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Looped Transformers boost expressivity by reusing shared layers across loops, yet at the cost of efficiency. Pushing their expressivity-efficiency frontier requires rethinking the core mechanism connecting adjacent loops: What should be passed as a Transformer loops? We introduce Mixture-of-Loops Transformer (MoLT), whose Mixture-of-Loops Attention (MoLA) uses keys and values (KV) as memory for selective reuse across depths and loops. Under loop residual, MoLT-R retains the residual stream and reads local KV across loops for expressivity. Under loop KV, MoLT-KV instead restarts from embeddings and reads current-loop local KV with preceding-loop memory KV at earlier positions for efficiency. MoLT-KV eliminates same-position cross-loop dependence and, paired with loop forcing for parallel training, unlocks single-traversal Mixture-of-Loops (MoL) decoding beyond the training loop horizon. tldr: 提出混合循环Transformer（MoLT），以KV缓存作为跨深度和跨循环的选择性记忆重用机制，在表达能力与效率之间取得新平衡，并支持超越训练循环次数的高效解码。
en_tdlr: Proposes Mixture-of-Loops Transformer (MoLT), which leverages KV as memory for selective reuse across depths and loops, striking a new balance between expressivity and efficiency while enabling efficient decoding beyond the training loop horizon.
